elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires Contractor, at Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Clause (i) expressly provides transition assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Clause (i) states that the assistance will be provided at Contractor's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) requires Contractor, within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination, to return all defined Company Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) expressly requires return in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires Contractor, after the return, to delete all Company Data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after the return.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires Contractor to certify the deletion in writing to Company.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires Contractor to provide transition assistance at Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The provision makes assistance available for up to six months, which includes the requested 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The requirement to return all Company Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty (30) days constitutes the required data export.

result.reason: The added operative language fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It includes the required trigger, party direction, six-month assistance period, then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, subsequent deletion, and written deletion certification. The amendment is confined to post-termination obligations and does not alter unrelated commercial terms. Drafting quality is reduced by the undefined scope of "reasonable transition assistance," the lack of a specific deadline for deletion and certification after return, and existing duplication and grammatical errors in Section 6(c), although those issues do not prevent satisfaction of the stated rule.
